# IAS
> Integral Ad Science provides digital media quality measurement, verification, optimization, and fraud protection solutions for advertisers, publishers, platforms, and media buyers.

IAS offers products and resources focused on ad verification, brand safety and suitability, viewability, invalid traffic detection, contextual targeting, and media quality analytics across channels.

## Product Overview
- [Products](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/products/): Overview of IAS media quality, verification, optimization, and measurement solutions.
- [Brand Safety & Suitability](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/products/brand-safety-suitability/): Tools for protecting campaigns with suitability controls and brand safety measurement.
- [Viewability](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/products/viewability/): Measurement and optimization solutions for ad viewability across digital environments.
- [Invalid Traffic](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/products/invalid-traffic/): Detection and prevention tools for ad fraud and invalid traffic.
- [Context Control](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/products/context-control/): Contextual classification and targeting capabilities for suitable content alignment.
- [Quality Attention](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/products/quality-attention/): Attention-based measurement designed to evaluate meaningful ad engagement.

## Solutions by Audience
- [Advertisers](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/solutions/advertisers/): Media quality and performance solutions tailored for brands and agencies.
- [Publishers](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/solutions/publishers/): Yield, inventory quality, and monetization support for publishers.
- [Platforms](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/solutions/platforms/): Verification and transparency solutions for media platforms and ecosystems.
- [Agencies](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/solutions/agencies/): Cross-channel campaign measurement and protection for agency teams.

## Channels and Environments
- [Desktop Display](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/solutions/desktop-display/): Verification and optimization support for desktop display advertising.
- [Mobile Web](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/solutions/mobile-web/): Measurement and protection for campaigns running in mobile browsers.
- [Mobile In-App](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/solutions/mobile-in-app/): In-app verification and fraud protection for mobile app advertising.
- [Video](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/solutions/video/): Brand safety, viewability, and fraud measurement for video campaigns.
- [Connected TV](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/solutions/connected-tv/): Transparency and media quality solutions for CTV advertising.
- [Social Media](https://www.adsafeprotected.com/solutions/social-media/): Verification capabilities for campaigns across major social platforms.
